hard: This is test-surface decomposition only. No production file may change, and no semantic authority may move. Operator remains the single Human-facing facade; Correction Preflight remains read-only readiness authority; Unified State remains the deterministic lifecycle reducer; Unified Human Surface continues to delegate at most one existing authoritative operation.

Tests outside the three correction authorities remain in tests/test_operator.py. A regression that genuinely spans more than one correction authority must have one clear owning group or remain in the original module; it must not be copied into multiple files and executed redundantly.

If shared test-only fixtures/helpers are needed to avoid duplication, they may be extracted only to tests/operator_test_support.py. That module must contain support code only, must not become a fourth test suite, and must not import from test_*.py modules in a way that causes duplicate pytest collection or order-dependent behavior.
Each new correction test module must be independently collectable/runnable from the repository root under ordinary pytest semantics and must not rely on another test module having executed first.

Preserve existing negative/fail-closed coverage, exact lineage assertions, remote/local transport cases, historical-subject cases, and one-operation delegation assertions applicable to the moved correction surfaces.

Canonical verification for this TASK is one combined command covering the remaining Operator tests, all three new correction groups, and review-transport regressions. task.problem: Canonical performance audit of TASK-081 through TASK-090 found verification responsible for about one third of admitted runtime, with narrow TASK-086 correction candidates repeatedly running roughly 250+ Operator/review-transport tests for about 8-9 minutes. Current Runtime already supports REMEDIATION.affected_verification and executes the authored command list exactly once; RUN-091-002 demonstrated the intended economics when a narrow correction used one focused adapter test file, completing canonical verification in about 24 seconds. The immediate bottleneck for Operator corrections is therefore not a missing verifier or cache but the coarse physical test surface: Correction Preflight, Unified State, and Human-facing continuation regressions remain embedded in the very large tests/test_operator.py module. Before changing REPAIR evidence semantics or adding any verification-selection machinery, establish stable test boundaries that Brain-authored corrections can select deterministically and narrowly.
